understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each KA59 level by moving and (when needed) switching between selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a '+' in the semantic grid is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; a level is only won when all goals are simultaneously covered.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempt to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in that direction; moves can fail when blocked by walls, boundaries, or immovable objects, and some adjacent objects are pushable so a move can also push them if space allows. Levels may include multiple selectable pieces; control is switched with CLICK by providing the exact pixel coordinate of the target selectable’s position (same coordinate system as player.position and objects), and only the currently selected piece responds to movement each turn.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each KA59 level by moving and (when needed) switching between selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a '+' in the semantic grid is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; a level is only won when all goals are simultaneously covered.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempt to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in that direction; moves can fail when blocked by walls, boundaries, or immovable objects, and some adjacent objects are pushable so a move can also push them if space allows. Levels may include multiple selectable pieces; control is switched with CLICK by providing the exact pixel coordinate of the target selectable’s position (same coordinate system as player.position and objects), and only the currently selected piece responds to movement each turn.
